name: launcher_ui
title: Launcher UI
description: PAX launcher with SD/USB apps, GitHub Store, LAN discovery and network settings.
author: PAX contributors
about: Browse and launch PAX apps from SD or USB, install apps from the GitHub Store or a local PAX Supply server, and browse Internet Archive collections. Includes themes, backgrounds, favorites, tooltips and network settings with nearby Wi-Fi scanning. Network setup and firmware update controls require compatible PAX host firmware. No external game data is required.
changelog: 0.6.1: first GitHub Store release of the current launcher, including asynchronous lists, LAN discovery, Wi-Fi scanning, live connection details and optional tooltips.
controls: Touch or mouse: select an app or source
Mouse wheel or arrow keys: scroll lists
Settings: configure network, themes and tooltips
Hold Menu 3 s: return to the firmware launcher
